entries.title: Stellaris
entries.definitive_edition: Stellaris on Windows PC with current DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native modern PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC library
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original and most complete Stellaris route, with the full PC DLC library, mod support, keyboard-and-mouse controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility. Console Edition is valuable and now has native PS5/Xbox Series versions, but it is an adapted console route with no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, GOG, Microsoft Store, or Paradox and add the DLC packs you want for the full content path.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC release with full DLC/mod route and high-end capture/settings support.
all_releases.reason: primary: original, most complete, and best-supported route.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.
skip: useful native route, but Windows PC remains the preferred support/capture target.

all_releases.fidelity: Stellaris: Console Edition adapted for PS4 controls and console UI.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and superseded for console fidelity by PS5.

all_releases.fidelity: Stellaris: Console Edition adapted for Xbox One controls and console UI.
all_releases.reason: skip: valid console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and superseded for console fidelity by Xbox Series X/S.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 Console Edition route with Season 08-era support and DLC storefront.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong current-gen console route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and less mod/control flexibility.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S Console Edition route with 4K Ultra HD support and Game Pass access.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong current-gen console/subscription route, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC and less mod/control flexibility.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current-gen Console Edition is a strong couch/controller route, but PC remains the most complete, moddable, and capture-friendly version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console Edition is an adapted port route, not a separate mainline game. Stellaris expansions, species packs, and story packs are DLC rather than separate game entries.

entries.title: Stellaris: Galaxy Command

emulation.notes: Use a native mobile install; Android mirroring/capture can be used for streaming if needed.

primary.why: Galaxy Command is a mobile-only Stellaris spin-off. Android is the preferred archive route because it is easy to source on Google Play and easier to capture/test on common Android devices or compatible capture setups; iOS is an equivalent access route with no sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Install Stellaris: Galaxy Command from Google Play on Android, or use the App Store if you prefer iOS.

all_releases.reason: primary: best practical mobile archive/capture route.
skip: equivalent mobile access route, but Android is the easier capture/test recommendation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Android and iOS are equivalent mobile routes; Android is chosen for practical capture/testing.

entries.remaster_caveats: Galaxy Command is a mobile spin-off, not a port of the full PC Stellaris game.
